author: Contributor 04
body: Freezer B peaked again during the 02:00 defrost overlap. Three compressors and the dock heater started inside seven minutes. Logging it here until the controls review begins.
title: Overnight demand peak

author: Contributor 01
body: Confirmed. I inferred more timestamp precision than the export provides. I will mark the repeated hour ambiguous, exclude it from the baseline comparison, and add the supplied fixture.
title: Defect acknowledgement

author: Contributor 08
body: Finance asked whether Lantern is an energy-saving project. For the pilot, the agreed target is avoiding the monthly demand peak; total energy may stay flat or rise slightly.
title: Outcome definition

author: Contributor 01
body: Across the four staffed nights, overlapping eligible starts fell from 11 in the matched baseline windows to 3. One recommendation was held and one rejected by the controller. Peak-demand interpretation waits for the meter extract.
title: Operational trial count

author: Contributor 03
body: Proceed with a supervised trial in Chiller C. Keep recommendation mode. Do not enable fleet automation until the controller interface is supported and at least eight additional nights cover busier loading conditions.
title: Phase-two decision

author: Contributor 05
body: Chiller C has a different controller revision. The recommendation screen reads its state, but the vendor gateway rejects the proposed-delay field. Manual staggering is still possible.
title: Controller incompatibility

author: Contributor 04
body: Chiller C completed two manually staggered nights. No alarms, but the second night had too few eligible cycles to compare. We are pausing until the gateway question is answered.
title: Limited second-site trial

author: Contributor 09
body: The west meeting room labels are being replaced Friday. Please remove anything left on the whiteboard before noon.
title: Meeting room labels

author: Contributor 04
body: Freezer B supervisors still use the recommendation screen on selected high-load nights, roughly once or twice a month. It is not the default schedule, and I do not have a clean usage export because two shifts record holds on paper.
title: Later limited use

author: Contributor 08
body: Lantern evidence remains site-specific: four supervised Freezer B nights, two manual Chiller C nights, and intermittent later use reported by operations. No portfolio-wide measurement or fleet rollout has been completed.
title: Follow-up horizon status
